verdict.rationale: Luma's Ray page says its Reframe feature 'handles every aspect ratio' (luma-docs-8), which covers the aspect-ratio half of the story. The only resolution named is the 360p Draft tier (luma-docs-15); HDR and 16-bit EXR export (luma-docs-13, luma-docs-16) describe color depth and format, not 1080p+ delivery. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 16:9/9:16/1:1 output presets, any evidence of 1080p-or-higher rendering, confirmation that outputs are channel-ready without re-encoding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
